small_guidance:
- Add autotune configs with larger BLOCK_OC×BLOCK_SP tiles (e.g. 128×128, 256×64) at num_warps=8/stages=2-3 since OC=128 and POH*POW=3969 give plenty of work; the current best may be a smaller tile leaving SMs underutilized.
- Swap the program-id ordering so pid_oc is axis 0 and pid_sp is axis 1 (or swizzle by N), improving L2 reuse of the weight tile across spatial tiles within a batch.
- Precompute and pass the four x base offsets as a single vector and merge the four `tl.dot` calls into one accumulator over a 2×BLOCK_SP-wide x_tile (load BLOCK_SP*2 contiguous cols then reshape) to halve weight-tile reloads and reduce issue overhead.
large_guidance:
- Reorganize as one program per (N, OC tile, 2×2 output-pool tile) where the 2×2 conv outputs feeding a single pooled output are computed together by widening BLOCK_SP to 2*pool_w contiguous OW columns; this lets the same weight tile and overlapping x rows be reused 4× from registers/L1 instead of issuing 4 separate dots with reloaded x.
- Switch the GEMM-K loop to iterate over (kh, kw) on the outside and IC on the inside with IC contiguous in the weight layout (pre-permute weight to [OC, KH, KW, IC]); this makes the K-stride for x a simple +1 along IC and produces fully coalesced contiguous loads per (kh,kw) plane.
- Consider a persistent-CTA scheme: launch grid = #SMs, loop over (n, oc_tile, sp_tile) inside the kernel to amortize launch/setup and keep weight tiles resident across multiple output tiles of the same OC block.
